textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 science · Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Different regions of India have different foods. Many ingredients come from plants or animals, while mushrooms come from fungi. Water and salt come from other sources.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Different regions of India have different foods. Many ingredients come from plants or animals, while mushrooms come from fungi. Water and salt come from other sources.
beats.speakEn: Different regions of India have different foods. Many ingredients come from plants or animals, while mushrooms come from fungi. Water and salt come from other sources.

beats.en: The main components are carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water. Carbohydrates, such as in rice and roti, give energy. Proteins, in dal, eggs and milk, help growth and repair.
beats.speakEn: The main components are carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water. Carbohydrates, such as in rice and roti, give energy. Proteins, in dal, eggs and milk, help growth and repair.
